_meta.purpose: rail id -> tracker gate category. Consumed by scripts/factory/collect.mjs to set gate.category on every gate event sourced from a rail (an exit != 0 from .harness/audit/*.ndjson or a harness-check rail fail). Categories are the exact 10 keys of CATEGORIES in ~/Downloads/ai-factory-feature-tracker/factory-data.js (Security, Privacy, Performance, Correctness, Reliability, Scope, Accessibility, Consistency, Observability, Safety). Authored by Procyon from each rail's description+barrier_class in .harness/worldline-harness.config.json; Algol reviews and is the sign-off authority on this table.
_meta.fallback_rule: Any rail id present in audit ndjson but ABSENT from this table maps to the fallback_category 'Correctness' AND the collector emits a stderr warning 'unmapped rail: <id>' so the table stays complete by review pressure. Never silently drop an unmapped rail.
